senses.gloss: जगच्चक्षुस् jagac-cakṣus, n. eye of the world, 🞄sun.
जगज्जीव jagaj-jīva, m. living being in this 🞄world.
जगद jagada, m. companion, guardian.
जगदण्ड jagad-aṇḍa, n. mundane egg, universe: 🞄-ka, n. id..
जगुरि jág-uri, a. leading (road).
जग्गिक jaggika, m. N. of a man.
जग्ध jag-dhá, pp. of √ 1. jakṣ.

जग्धि jág-dhi, f. eating;
 food.
जग्ध्वाय jag-dhvā́-ya, gd. of √ 1. jakṣ.

जग्मि já-gm-i, a. going, nimble;
 hastening 🞄to (ac., lc.).
जागत jāgata, a. composed in jagatī metre.

जाग्रत् jāgr-at, pr. pt. watching;
 n. waking: 🞄-svapná, m. du. waking and sleep.
